risk_flags.reason: Route writes to sacred table `questions`: UPDATE (retire path) and INSERT (replacements). Reviewed against DEC-V5-12 enumerated pre-approval. UPDATE sets exactly retired_at/retired_reason='block_regenerated'/is_retired=1, scoped to block_id=? AND user_id=? AND retired_at IS NULL — matches the pre-approved exact_scope verbatim. INSERT is owner-scoped (document_id, block_id, user_id). No DELETE on questions anywhere; no other sacred-table write (session_answers/study_sessions/users/question_feedback untouched). All writes inside one db.transaction('write'). Within approved bounds — logged, not escalated.

AC6 met: verification suite ran and is evidenced — 18/18 checks pass including retire-vs-delete (0 deleted), cross-user scoping untouched, forced-conflict 409 full rollback, AI-failure 502 with unchanged counts, and blast-radius counts (session_answers 2→2, questions 9 new 0 deleted).
